bugs.error_message: Backend used global shared layers instead of module-owned Clean Architecture boundaries.
bugs.root_cause: Initial scaffolding grouped all future domains under shared Application, Domain, and Infrastructure projects.
bugs.fix: Moved the single API host into backend/src; created seven module-owned Contracts, Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Presentation project sets; updated solution, Docker paths, controller discovery, and structure documentation.

bugs.error_message: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'src'
bugs.root_cause: A redundant cleanup verification assumed the old directory still existed after the migration had already removed its empty directories.
bugs.fix: Verify that the retired src directory is absent; no further cleanup is needed.

bugs.error_message: User correction: repository is already the backend; backend/ wrapper is unnecessary.
bugs.root_cause: The initial restructuring assumed a parent repository containing a separate backend directory.
bugs.fix: Move source to root src and shared settings to root Directory.Build.props; update solution, Docker, container tooling, and documentation. Include all docs as solution items.

bugs.error_message: WSL shutil.move failed with PermissionError while moving backend/src; an old obj tree reappeared before final rmdir.
bugs.root_cause: Windows-mounted directory operations rejected WSL rename/removal, and design-time build artifacts were regenerated under paths still referenced by the solution.
bugs.fix: Verify copied source contents, use native Windows Node filesystem operations, update solution paths, and remove only the regenerated old build artifacts.

bugs.error_message: Implementation-plan static coverage check omitted literal ID-FR-06 because the document used ID-FR-05/06 shorthand.
bugs.root_cause: A combined shorthand requirement label was readable to a person but did not independently identify the Admin lookup requirement to the ID inventory check.
bugs.fix: Expanded both requirement IDs in the traceability table; rerun document/source/link coverage checks. The plan also received more than two editing passes during its initial review.

bugs.error_message: Identity plan refinement required more than two editing passes to align new architecture/library decisions with the phase tasks and numbering.
bugs.root_cause: The requested CQRS, FluentValidation, Options and package details needed both new design sections and corresponding updates to existing file/task ownership and installation steps.
bugs.fix: Added explicit decisions, feature tree, package versions/ownership and commands; updated consuming tasks; corrected the current-user validator exception and retained requirement traceability.
